# 🔥 VIRAL ANGLE OF THE WEEK (#2)
**Anti-dandruff · Sun Nov 1 – Sat Nov 7**
**2.4K views** · @rosabelventas · Head & Shoulders Clinical Strength Shampoo
https://www.tiktok.com/@rosabelventas/video/7703797661312290078

# 🎣 THE HOOK: "Caspa, cabello graso?"
-# (Dandruff, greasy hair?) · on screen from second 1
Three words name two problems at once, over a real customer comment, all in 12 seconds.
**1- Someone else does the selling:**
She replies to a viewer: "Si sirve es muy bueno es el único que ah ayudado con la caspa."
-# (It works, it's really good, it's the only one that's helped with my dandruff.)
**2- Two bottles, not one:**
She opens on a pair in a basket. It reads as "I buy this again", not a one-off try.
**3- Texture on camera:**
A pour into her palm at second 3. Viewers see the product, not just the label.
**4- Short and done:**
12 seconds, one caption, no talking. Easy to watch twice.
# 🚀 MAKE IT WORK FOR OUR KETO BUNDLE
Our buyer has tried every shampoo on the shelf. Let a real comment do the convincing.
**1- Reply to a real comment, bundle in frame:**
"Caspa, picazón, cuero cabelludo reseco?"
-# (Dandruff, itching, dry scalp?)
**2- Show all three, then the texture:**
Shampoo, conditioner, scalp spray lined up. Pour the shampoo into your palm on camera.
**3- Why it's different, in one line:**
"Most dandruff is fungal. This targets the root, not just the flakes."
-# (ES: "La mayoría de la caspa es por hongos. Esto va a la raíz.")
**4- 2–3 benefits, plain words:**
reduces visible flakes · calms my scalp · gentle enough for regular use
**5- Close with the cart:**
"Te lo dejo en el carrito naranja."
-# (I'll leave it for you in the orange cart.)
**✅ On-brief:** product visible early, bottle open and used · "calms"/"reduces flakes", never "cures"/"treats" · no "100% gone" · no prices · no other brand names
